sources.entry: Beautifulsoup - While not new, it's a powerful Python library for web scraping that has gained renewed interest due to AI-driven data processing needs.

summary.name: Beautiful Soup
summary.one_liner: Beautiful Soup is a Python library for parsing HTML and XML and navigating, searching, and modifying the parse tree, mainly for screen-scraping projects.
use_cases: Scraping data from poorly structured websites
Finding all links or elements matching a class or URL pattern
Extracting text from a specific table heading or tag
Migrating legacy Python 2 scraping code to Python 3
Parsing news feeds or web pages for representative images
summary.what_it_does: Beautiful Soup provides simple methods and Pythonic idioms for navigating, searching, and modifying a parsed document tree. It automatically converts incoming documents to Unicode and outgoing documents to UTF-8, though an encoding may need to be specified if it cannot be detected. It sits on top of parsers such as lxml and html5lib, so users can choose between parsing strategies that trade speed for flexibility. The current release is 4.14.3 (November 30, 2025), installable with pip as beautifulsoup4; it is also packaged for Debian, Ubuntu, and Fedora.
notable: Sits on top of lxml and html5lib so parsers can be swapped
MIT licensed; can be copied directly into a project as the bs4/ directory
Used by projects such as the New York Times lobby art piece and the Python bug tracker migration
caveats: Supports Python 3.7 and greater; Python 2 support was discontinued January 1, 2021
Beautiful Soup 3 does not support Python 3 and is discontinued; users should migrate to version 4
The beautifulsoup PyPI package name will be reclaimed by a newer version, which will break Python 2 code using Beautiful Soup 3
